content.title: ADC Therapeutics updates data from Phase 1b trial of Zynlonta in lymphoma
content.summary: ADC Therapeutics (ADCT) announced updated data from the LOTIS-7 Phase 1b open-label clinical trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of Zynlonta in combination with the bispecific antibody glofitamab – Columvi – in patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, or r/r DLBCL. The updated data reflects the 49 efficacy-evaluable patients with a minimum of 6 months of follow-up from treatment initiation.
